entry.name: AI Engineering in Python
entry.note: A project-based learning path with a completion certificate, not a proctored exam
entry.audience: Career changers who want to learn by building projects

covers: Python programming and developer tooling such as the command line, Git and virtual environments
Working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering and tool use
Building and deploying AI applications with FastAPI and Docker
Data analysis and visualization with pandas, NumPy and matplotlib
Supervised and unsupervised machine learning with scikit-learn
Embeddings, vector databases and semantic search
reading.format: An online learning path. Learners write code and receive feedback directly in the browser, and complete several guided projects involving realistic business scenarios.
reading.summary: AI Engineering in Python is a Dataquest learning path that begins with Python fundamentals and ends with deploying production AI systems. It covers working with large language models through APIs, prompt engineering, data analysis, machine learning, deep learning with PyTorch, embeddings, vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation. Learners work through guided projects based on realistic business scenarios and finish with a portfolio of AI applications. The page describes it as a career path from zero to job-ready in 10 months.
reading.audience: People starting from the beginning who want the technical skills AI engineers need and a portfolio to prepare for interviews. The page presents it as a route from no prior experience to job-ready.
reading.prerequisites: The page states the path starts with Python fundamentals and takes learners from zero to job-ready, so no prior experience is given as required.
